build.summary:
KS-N7 is done, with Complex still the default. A new BoxTransform::PairedReal option packs the x-rows two at a time as u + i v, separates them by R Z(m) = conj Z(nx-m), and transforms only the Hermitian half along y and z. It needs about half the FFT lines (0.502 at 256x256) and about half the buffer memory. A new stage_solver(z) prepares once and reuses its plans and buffers; it is what the timing test measures.

Over 320 cases on 16 box grids (all box grids of the existing tests plus odd, minimum-size, prime-nx and 3-D sizes), PairedReal matches Complex to round-off: largest relative difference 1.874e-15. Its T1/T2 maxima are 8.110e-16 and 4.545e-17, against the 1e-13 bounds. The default arm still gives the recorded 3.373e-16 and 5.110e-17. Whole-IVP runs match the dense reference with the same attempts as Complex. Tests, clippy, fmt and verify_run all pass.

The timing verdict is not run; it is the orchestrator's owner-host cell. Smoke timings on the loaded agent host (diagnostic only) give 0.20 of Complex at 256x256. That ratio also reflects layout and index-arithmetic changes, not only the pairing.

build.verdict: PairedReal is implemented as an opt-in option and Complex stays the default. It agrees with Complex to round-off and meets the T1/T2 bounds on every tested box grid. The 0.6 timing acceptance is NOT_RUN and waits for the orchestrator's owner-host cell.

rulings: spatial.rs (the re-export list) is outside KS-N7's allowed paths and was not edited. BoxTransform therefore implements FromStr and Display, and the tests select it by name.

Added SeparableStages::stage_solver(z), returning impl FnMut + Send + use<>: plans and buffers are built once, as in the driver. The measurement times this by default; KS_N7_SCOPE=solve_stage times the existing per-call construction instead.
PairedReal projects the DC and Nyquist entries to their real parts on the way back (irfft semantics), so no round-off leaks between the two rows of a pair.
open_issues: At merge, add BoxTransform to the `pub use separable::{...}` line in crates/vigilode/src/spatial.rs (one line; outside KS-N7's paths). Until then the type cannot be named outside the crate; it is selected with .parse().

Timing cell for the orchestrator: KS_N7_ARM=complex|paired KS_N7_GRID=256x256 KS_N7_SOLVES=N, test spatial_separable::measure_box_transform_one_arm with --ignored --exact. One arm per process; the output line is prefixed KS_N7_MEASURE.

Attribution caveat: the timing gain also comes from the x-mode-major layout (no strided gathers along y) and from dropping the Complex arm's per-element integer index arithmetic. An index-free division loop could speed up the Complex default without changing its bits; this was not done.
The log of the first, pre-commit test run was overwritten when the run was repeated at the code head (an untracked-file git mv was silently skipped). Its printed values were identical.
